messages:
Ravi (Infra): Follow-up from today's all-hands: short thread on EU capacity sequencing, autoscaler defaults, and procurement notes. Posting answers and next steps.

Maya (SRE): Do we have an ordering for EU zones? Which zones go live first?

Ravi (Infra): Order: eu-west-1 alpha pool, eu-central-1 beta pool. Alpha will be used for hosted low-latency routes; beta for Dedicated onboarding.

Ellen (Product): For Dedicated customers who asked for EU placement, will they be auto-migrated?

Ravi (Infra): We'll reach out to confirm. No auto-migration without customer signoff. Priority is given to contracts with start dates in Q3.

Zoe (Runtime): Autoscaler defaults updated: local_buffer=0.12, cross_region_allowed=true, predicted_p99_threshold=175ms. Canary starts next Thursday.

Maya (SRE): Is predicted_p99 per-route or global?

Zoe (Runtime): Per-route with org-wide default. Teams can opt into stricter SLAs.

stock-bot: Procurement update: PO#10456 placed for mixed A100/H100 capacity; ETA window 2090150000 - 2090220000.

Ellen (Product): Action: add "cross-region opt-out" checkbox to Console route settings. I'll take it.

Ravi (Infra): We'll publish a short note in the infra docset with expected latency deltas. If anyone needs raw benchmark numbers earlier, DM me.

Maya (SRE): Thanks. I'll join the canary review.

Zoe (Runtime): I'll post canary logs to the #eng channel when it starts.

Ravi (Infra): Closing thread for now  feel free to ping for customer-specific details.
